title: Menswear writer Derek Guy on Zelenskyy’s lack of suit in the WH:...
content: Menswear writer Derek Guy on Zelenskyy’s lack of suit in the WH: “I dislike the idea of respectability in dress…because it conflates the *appearance* of virtue with *actual* virtue. Wearing a suit doesn’t make you respectful, intelligent, or capable.”
author: Jason Kottke
